about.intro: FursadHub bridges students, organizations and universities through real internship workflows that support learning and career development.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Connect students with real opportunities, organizations with emerging talent, and universities with clearer internship outcomes.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: A trusted internship ecosystem where education and meaningful workplace experience work together.

reasons.organizations: Organizations need access to capable emerging talent.
reasons.platform: FursadHub connects these workflows in one platform.

about.countsHint: Live counts from the public directories. Nothing here is an estimate.
about.journeyTitle: How an internship runs on FursadHub
about.journeyHint: One pipeline from posting to completion. Public applications and university nominations feed the same candidate list.

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.body: An organization publishes an internship openly, targets specific universities and departments, or does both at once.

candidacy.title: One candidate pipeline
candidacy.body: A student applies directly, or a department coordinator nominates them with their consent. Either route produces exactly one candidacy per student and internship.

offer.title: Offer and placement
offer.body: Recruitment moves through explicit steps. When a student accepts an offer, the placement is created in the same transaction.

supervision.title: Supervision
supervision.body: Weekly logs, attendance, and both university and organization supervisors, according to the policy the university sets.

completion.title: Evaluation and completion
completion.body: Evaluation, final report and defence where the policy requires them, and a completion record that stays tied to the right academic context.

students.title: Students
students.body: Browse and apply once your university has verified your enrollment, then run your placement, logs and reports in one place.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.body: Publish internships, request nominees from partner universities, screen one candidate list, and supervise the interns you take on.

universities.title: Universities
universities.body: Verify your own students, nominate them to targeted internships, set the internship policy, and supervise placements through to completion.

about.trustHint: Stated plainly, because trust is easier to keep than to rebuild.

trust.biometrics: No facial recognition, biometric identity checks or biometric attendance.
trust.evidence: Verification evidence and private documents are never public, and every download is authorized and audited.
trust.testimonials: Only testimonials written by real users and published by a moderator appear on this site.
trust.pilot: The pilot is free. There is no payment processing anywhere in the product.

lifecycle.title: One pipeline, start to finish
lifecycle.body: A placement doesn't end at the offer. FursadHub carries it through weekly logs, attendance, supervision from both sides, evaluation and a final defense — so universities and organizations can see real progress, not just a hire date.
